title: ArchiveMute::reload mirrors the Fetch stage of ChatListState::archive_settings for the same request
trigger: The server suggests 'Hide new chats?' while an older getArchiveChatListSettings is in flight (reload_archive_chat_list_settings returns Ok(None) on has_purpose), or the answer is rejected by archive_settings.answered.
effect: reload goes Reloading -> Idle on the older answer (note_settings) although it predates the suggestion, so the box can open from a pre-suggestion copy; the Reloading/Failed state is kept in step with archive_settings Loading/Failed by three hand-written call sites (error.rs:218, connect/chat_list/mod.rs:402,415, apply.rs:226) and holds no RequestId.
fix: Drop ArchiveReload and derive 'waiting for a fresh copy' from archive_settings (Fetch::Loading with the id of a request sent after the suggestion), or store the RequestId in Reloading and match it in note_settings/note_reload_failed

title: A panic inside the D-Bus listener leaves OPEN and STATE set, so the watcher never falls back to polling
trigger: listen() panics (zbus) on the quill-battery-signal thread; spawn_guarded catches it, so the cleanup after the loop (OPEN = None; record(None)) is skipped, and the Once never restarts the listener.
effect: event_driven() stays true and battery_saving::probe keeps answering from the last announced value (or a dead connection), so battery-saver changes are not noticed until restart.
fix: Run the cleanup from a drop guard (or after the guarded join result) so the listener's end, normal or by panic, always returns STATE to NOT_LISTENING

title: baseline: BarFacts::bot_start_pending
trigger: Open a bot chat
effect: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt; computed per render in ui/bottom_action.rs from bot_start_params.contains_key || empty history, so it is derived not stored, but still a stage-named bool
fix: Rename to a derived BotStart enum (Armed/Empty/None) or allow-list as a derived fact

title: Gesture::key and Gesture::action are two Options set together and read together
trigger: Two-finger swipe on a chat row
effect: update() assigns both from the same tuple; end() destructures both and returns if either is None; the Orientation enum already says whether they were fixed
fix: Orientation::Horizontal { key, action } (or Option<(K, A)>)

title: baseline: ChatSwipeFacts::is_saved
trigger: Chat list row facts
effect: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt (twice); it is a fact about the chat (the chat with yourself), not a stage, so it belongs in implicit-state-allow.txt with that reason
fix: Move to implicit-state-allow.txt and drop both baseline lines

title: baseline: RowMenuFacts::is_saved_messages
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A fact about the chat (it is Saved Messages) read once when the row menu is built, not a request stage; still listed as debt rather than in implicit-state-allow.txt with a reason
fix: Move to implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason, or replace with a ChatRole enum (Saved, Normal) shared with ChatSwipeFacts/HeaderFacts

title: PhonePrompt {Asking, NotMine} is the 'No pressed' bool beside the actions set, reset by hand and written by the UI
trigger: Press 'No' on the phone suggestion in Settings; TDLib removes and re-adds suggestedActionCheckPhoneNumber
effect: The prompt stage is kept in step with membership of ACTION_PHONE in SuggestionFacts::actions by reset_phone_prompt (only add_action/remove_action), and ui/settings_phone_suggestion.rs:86 writes phone_prompt = NotMine directly. Works today; any other writer of actions (direct inserts) would leave a stale NotMine
fix: Make the phone action carry its stage (e.g. actions: BTreeMap<Action, ActionStage>, or PhoneSuggestion {Absent, Asking, NotMine}) with a method answer_no()

title: baseline: ChecklistDraft::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A user setting of the new checklist ('Allow Others to Mark As Done'), matched by the word 'done'; not a stage, but still listed as debt (same for Checklist, ChecklistDialog, ChecklistSend outside this file)
fix: Move the four entries to implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason (a TDLib permission mirrored as is)

title: Children no thread could reap are parked in a static Vec polled only by the next failure; reap_after_notice reports 'gone' when it was not reaped
trigger: std::thread::Builder::spawn fails (thread limit/OOM) in wait_in_background or reap_after_with
effect: PARKED is polled only when another wait_in_background spawn fails, so a parked child stays a zombie for the life of the process; in reap_after_with a failed spawn drops the notice sender at once, so reap_after_notice receivers (proxy_carrier helper exiting, web_app_ui close_with_notice) see Disconnected as 'helper gone' while the killed child may not be reaped yet (at most ~50 ms of polling, then left to the OS)
fix: Poll PARKED from a periodic upkeep or on every call, and send the notice only after try_wait reports exit (keep the sender in the parked entry)

title: LookupStage::Unsent is a construction-time stage that must be overwritten by the sender; is_loading counts it as loading
trigger: CollectibleLookup::new then any path that stores the lookup without request_collectible_info (tests do: collectible_info_ui_tests, on_screen_session_box_tests)
effect: A stored lookup in Unsent has no RequestId, nothing can answer it (answer/fail match only Loading), nothing leaves it, and is_loading() stays true. request_collectible_info is the only code that moves it to Loading, by writing the field directly
fix: Build the lookup as an argument (LookupSpec) and construct CollectibleLookup only as Loading(request) from the sender, so Unsent is unrepresentable

title: baseline: FastShareFacts::sent (server has the message) is a bool next to other facts
trigger: a message still sending vs sent
effect: none today; a pure per-row fact computed each render, not a held stage
fix: read the message's SendState enum (Sent variant) instead of a bool copy

title: Seed::InFlight duplicates the presets Fetch and the request registry: three holders of one request's stage
trigger: open Settings > Data and Storage on an unseeded account
effect: Seed::InFlight (data_storage.seeded), settings.auto_download_presets (Fetch Loading) and requests.has_purpose(GetAutoDownloadSettingsPresets) are set in step by hand in fetch_auto_download_presets (connect/settings/storage.rs:70-85) and reset separately in state/domains/settings/error.rs:69-77; the answer is matched by purpose, not by the RequestId held in the stage
fix: one Fetch<Presets> holding the RequestId; Seed becomes Seeded/Unseeded (persisted bool) only

title: storage_limits_seeded stays InFlight when TDLib refuses a setOption
trigger: first Ready of an account with no chosen limits; setOption(storage option) answers an error
effect: state/domains/settings/error.rs:42-47 only fails data_storage_save for SetStorageOption and never returns storage_limits_seeded to Unseeded, so maybe_seed_storage_limits (connect/settings/storage.rs:228) returns early for the rest of the process although its doc says a refused option is sent again on the next Ready; cache limits are not applied until restart
fix: leave InFlight on the SetStorageOption error arm (key the stage to the four option RequestIds) or drop InFlight and use Seeded/Unseeded

title: Launcher::Pending sticks forever when the badge worker thread cannot be spawned
trigger: spawn_guarded fails (thread limit) inside WORKER.call_once; the Once is spent and the result is ignored with `let _ =`
effect: request() sees Pending(asked)==unread and never hands the count over again; the Linux dock badge stays wrong until the count changes, and then Pending(new) sticks too
fix: Make a failed spawn answer Pending as Failed and reset the Once (or hold the worker in the stage)

title: Three layers track one fact (what the dock shows): LAST_SENT, INVALIDATED and Launcher
trigger: Any badge push
effect: LAST_SENT (UI dedupe) and Launcher::Delivered (worker dedupe) must be invalidated together by forget_pushed_badge by hand
fix: One BadgeStage owner (Idle/Pending/Delivered/Failed) used by both the platform push and the dedupe

title: Test sleeps 20 ms to let the consumer thread block
trigger: latest_slot_wakes_a_blocked_consumer
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule)
fix: Use a channel handshake instead of a sleep

title: request_approval and subscription are two bools that exclude each other, beside locked_stars
trigger: toggle_approval clears subscription and toggle_subscription clears request_approval by hand; edit_link derives both from locked_stars
effect: Any new writer can set both true (approval and a fee together)
fix: enum LinkKind { Plain{approval}, Subscription{locked_stars} }

title: Saved line layouts hold every account's chat names but are written to the last opened account's file
trigger: Open account A, switch to B (SLOT becomes Open(B)), quit: gpui_macos::line_cache::save writes the process-wide layouts, including A's chat names and previews, sealed with B's key; if A logged out (Forgotten) a later B open reopens the slot with A's text still in the cache
effect: A's chat names persist on disk under B's account folder after A's logout
fix: Clear the line cache on forget()/account switch, or key layouts per account

title: GLYPHS_SAVED is set before the save runs and is never cleared
trigger: chat_list_drawn first call: swap(true) then the thread spawn fails, or the launch is locked (launch_lines SLOT still Empty) and the save writes nothing
effect: Glyph and line caches are never written this run; glyphs_pending() reports false though nothing was saved
fix: Enum Pending/Saving/Saved set by the saver on completion; Pending again on a failed spawn

title: MEDIA_CACHE_SCOPE is process-wide, so scratch producers of a background account use the on-screen account's folder
trigger: Account A on screen starts a recording or webm decode on a worker; user switches to B (set_media_cache_scope(B)); the worker calls media_cache_base() later; also sweep_account_media_cache() on logout sweeps the scope at call time, not the account that logged out
effect: A's decrypted scratch lands in B's folder and is removed with B's, or B's logout misses A's; cross-account leak of decrypted media
fix: Pass the AccountKey (OfAccount) to media_cache_base callers instead of a global

title: A sweep that clears VERDICTS between a display check and its insert leaves a 60 s verdict for a removed file
trigger: sandboxed_display_path runs the uncached check, sweep_media_caches/sweep_account_media_cache clears the memo, the check then inserts a plain-file verdict with VERDICT_TTL_PLAIN
effect: The image path is accepted for up to 60 s after its file is gone
fix: Insert only if a sweep generation is unchanged

title: Test polls with thread::sleep until the tombstone thread finishes
trigger: sweep_removes_dirs_at_once_and_tombstones_in_background
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule)
fix: Join the sweep thread or make the sweep injectable

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in utc_offset_at
trigger: The offset lookup (OS call) re-enters utc_offset_at on the same thread
effect: BorrowMutError panic on the UI thread; none today since os_utc_offset_at does not call back
fix: Use try_borrow_mut and fall back to the lookup, or a Cell<(i64, i32)>

title: The start-in-tray reveal watcher is a detached task whose `waited` counter lives in the closure
trigger: --start-minimized: the poll loop runs until tray_startup_reveal answers or the window dies
effect: The stage (waiting for the tray host, revealed, gave up) is not held by an owner and cannot be cancelled by a lock or settings change
fix: Hold the Task in the tray owner's stage (Registering{task}, Ready, GaveUp)

title: accept_result overwrites any non-Sending stage with Failed("") before checking it is Sending
trigger: accept_result called while stage is Loading, Quoted or Sent (callers guard with waits_for today, the type does not)
effect: The in-flight Loading request id, the quote or the Sent receipt is replaced by an empty failure with no note
fix: Match on &self.stage first and only replace it in the Sending arm

title: A device probe that times out is read as an empty list, so the picked device silently becomes the default
trigger: ffmpeg -sources/-list_devices takes over 3 s (capture_within -> None -> unwrap_or_default) while a non-default camera or microphone is picked
effect: Recording starts on the system default device, not the pick, and the UI thread waited up to 3 s per probe
fix: Return Result, show 'could not list devices' and keep the pick; run the probe off the UI thread

title: linux_audio_backend memoizes the first probe for the process, even when it timed out or ffmpeg was missing
trigger: First capture with ffmpeg missing or slow: stdout_within returns None, pick_audio_backend("") returns "pulse" and the LazyLock keeps it
effect: ALSA-only machines fail every later capture until restart
fix: Cache only a successful probe

title: Test uses a real 100 ms timeout and a `sleep 30` child
trigger: stderr_within_returns_output_and_gives_up_on_a_stuck_command
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule: no sleeps or timeouts)
fix: Inject a manual clock/fake child
